verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents one. Filters & Rules, scheduled send, snooze and templates are conventional automation, not AI task delegation. The JMAP API and API tokens are developer building blocks for building external agents, not a built-in assistant. One user's report that Fastmail lacks Gmail-style auto-categorization and summary cards does not speak to an assistant either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
